test_overview:
Evaluated the admin synonym management test plan against the Furniture Delivery Calculator app (3 steps, 26 full points). All steps passed.

Step 1 (test_tier3_fails_without_relevant_synonym, 7 pts): Created a B2C quote from Warehouse Central (Metroville) to "Harbor City" (blank suburb, 1× Chair 0.20 m³, all services 0) with no Harbor/Harbour synonym configured. Calculate produced the unavailable state: "No rate card for selected route and delivery type." with Save Quote present and enabled — PASS (both non-fatal checks also passed).

Step 2 (test_add_synonym_enables_approximate_match, 12 pts): Added synonym Canonical=Harbor / Alternate=Harbour in Admin > Settings > Matching Synonyms (persisted immediately via Save). Returning to the Calculator with identical inputs and clicking Calculate yielded badge "Approximate" with explanation "Matched to: Harbour City" (original rate-card values). Pricing verified directly in the calculator results view (all required fields present there): ratePerM3 $150.00; total item volume 0.20 m³; Volume Charged 1.00 m³ with min-applied hint "(charged as 1.00 m³)"; Base Delivery $150.00; Assembly/Rubbish/Rural $0.00 each; Total $150.00. The "view all approximate matches" affordance correctly did not appear (single candidate) per implementation (candidates >= 2). Clicked Save Quote, creating QUOTE_APPROX (quote id 1; list shows B2C, Metroville → Harbor City, Approximate, $150.00) — PASS.

Step 3 (test_delete_synonym_reverts_to_unavailable, 7 pts): Deleted the Harbor/Harbour synonym (confirmed the dialog; table back to 6 seeded pairs). Re-running the same calculation reverted to the Unavailable state ("No rate card for selected route and delivery type.") — PASS. Non-fatal immutability check: QUOTE_APPROX detail (/quotes/1) is unchanged — still Approximate with "Matched to: Harbour City", rate $150.00, volume charged 1.00 m³ (minimum 1.00 m³), and total $150.00 — PASS.

No failures observed; behavior matched the test plan exactly. Total: 26/26.

steps.description: test_tier3_fails_without_relevant_synonym: B2C quote Warehouse Central -> 'Harbor City' (blank suburb, 1x Chair, services 0) with no Harbor/Harbour synonym. Same quote calculation reverted to Unavailable ('No rate card for selected route and delivery type.'). Non-fatal: QUOTE_APPROX detail unchanged - still Approximate, 'Matched to: Harbour City', rate $150.00, volume charged 1.00 m3 (minimum), total $150.00. All passed.
